flow: Review is per view (lock) or on the concept sheet. fix_requests carry view_id. Items with edit_eligible allow edit_previous_view.

items.label: An element is in the wrong place compared with another view
items.instruction: Place the named anchor exactly where the layout puts it as seen from this camera, translating left and right through the orientation system.

items.label: The reverse view is just a mirror of the Hero
items.instruction: Show the sides that were behind the Hero camera using the layout's contents for them; do not flip the Hero.

items.label: A door or window was invented or moved
items.instruction: Remove any opening or fixed structure that is not in the layout and restore the ones that are.

items.label: Architecture or materials changed
items.instruction: Match architecture, materials, colors and wear to the Hero exactly.

items.label: Lighting differs from the other views
items.instruction: Use the Hero's time of day, light direction logic, weather and palette.

items.label: A person, text or label appears
items.instruction: Remove all people, figures, text and labels.

items.label: Detail view is blurry or just a crop
items.instruction: Make it a true close-up, sharp and in focus, with the same material and wear.

items.label: The style differs from the Hero
items.instruction: Render in exactly the Hero's style; match form language, materials, surface rendering and light.

items.label: Concept sheet layout is wrong (concept only)
items.instruction: Follow the fixed layout: left half the Hero, right half the alternate as a full-width top panel and two detail panels side by side below, thin even gutters, four panels, no text.

items.label: I want a different angle
items.instruction: Change the camera as stated in the note, keeping the space identical.

items.label: I want a different detail
items.instruction: Change the detail as stated in the note, from things that exist in the spec.

items.label: Something else (write it)
items.instruction: Apply the user's note without changing DNA or layout.

items.label: This needs a design change (layout, openings, materials, or the proposed unseen part)
